text:
lucy: Customer report from HelixBio: Jan invoice duplicated, one copy missing embedding line items and totals differ by $0.01. Ticket #BILL-9120. PDFs attached.
billing-bot: reconcile-nightly job rec-90123 completed 2025-03-25T06:00:00Z. Alerts: duplicate invoice detected for customer_id=HB-77, period=2025-01.
tom: invoice ids?
lucy: INV-2025-9901 and INV-2025-9901-dup. INV-2025-9901 (created first) shows subtotal 1234.56 but embeddings missing; dup has embeddings but total is 1234.57. Customer sees both.
tom: quick log pull -> generator hit a rounding anomaly in discount calc (float rounding to 2dp) while line_items write stalled then retried. Retry path created a second invoice record before the first got its line items attached. snippet: ```
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z ERROR invoice_writer: attach_line_items timeout
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z WARN invoice_writer: computed_total=1234.565 -> rounded 1234.56
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: retrying create (idempotency_key=null)
2025-01-31T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: created INV-2025-9901-dup (with embeddings) -> total rounded 1234.57
```
tom: root causes: (1) non-atomic line_items attach + invoice create, (2) idempotency missing when request_id null, (3) money handled as floats causing off-by-one-cent after rounding.
rebecca: Customer wants corrected invoice + credit. Recommend void duplicate and issue credit for the duplicate amount, then reconcile canonical invoice to include embeddings and correct rounded total.
ops-approval: Approve emergency remediation: void INV-2025-9901-dup and credit up to $1k. Authorize immediate manual action.
lucy: running quickfix: `./tools/finance/void_and_credit --invoice INV-2025-9901-dup --reason "duplicate retry"`
lucy: done. Credit CR-5123 created for $1,234.57, INV-2025-9901-dup voided. Notified CS and customer. Ticket updated #BILL-9120.
tom: Plan: hotfix to (a) calculate money in integer cents everywhere, (b) wrap invoice + line_items in DB transaction so attach is atomic, (c) use fallback idempotency key = sha256(customer_id + period + usage_checksum) when request_id null. Will open PR and include integration test that simulates attach_line_items timeout. Target: hotfix release today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/invoice-generator/pull/478 (WIP).
rebecca: Add runbook step: before any void/credit, search for invoices for same customer+period created within 5 minutes and compare line_items & totals. Add alert to surface invoices for same customer+period created within 3 minutes.
lucy: closing loop for now  manual remediation done, customer notified, eng hotfix in progress, postmortem requested (BILL-9120-PM). tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up. :thumbsup:
